profile.summary: AyoubElk is a **Senior JavaScript developer** with deep expertise in **Fastify**, a high-performance Node.js framework. Their contributions focus on **core Fastify internals**, including **lifecycle hooks (onSend, onRoute, preSerialization)**, **HTTP server hijacking**, and **middleware extensibility**. Strong in **Node.js backend patterns**, **async/await workflows**, and **API design**, they demonstrate proficiency in **debugging edge cases**, **dependency upgrades**, and **SemVer-compliant releases**. Their work spans **testing infrastructure**, **documentation clarity**, and **performance-critical optimizations**, making them a key contributor to Fastify’s architecture.
